mood: Warm, Mediterranean modern, inviting, elegant yet accessible. Reflects the recently painted beige, brown, and white structure.

typography.rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Headings must be evocative and elegant. Body text should be clean and readable with generous line height.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use Tailwind scales p-8, p-12, p-16. Containers with borders must have internal padding. Avoid symmetrical center-aligned monotony.
spacing_and_layout.hero_section: Immersive and asymmetric. Use a large beach image with a maximum 30%-40% warm overlay (bg-black/30 or gradient) so the image remains clear. Bold serif typography aligned left.
spacing_and_layout.services_grid: Bento 'Tetris' grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12) with varying spans. Mix text cards with image cards.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Warm brown primary color. Must include subtle hover scaling (-translate-y-1) and drop shadow.
components.cards: Subtle border (border-border), no hard shadow. Flat surfaces rather than heavy glassmorphism. Tactile and clean.
components.booking_form: React form that compiles state and opens 'https://wa.me/NUMBER?text=URL_ENCODED_STRING'.
components.sticky_cta: Mobile-only fixed bottom button 'Prenota su WhatsApp' (z-50). Desktop: elegant floating or header button.

micro_interactions.hover_states: Hovering buttons changes text and background color. Hovering feature cards creates a slight lift.
micro_interactions.images: Slow zoom/pan on hover within overflow-hidden containers to give a premium feel.

testing.requirements: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form inputs) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind config to use 'Playfair Display' and 'Outfit' fonts via Google Fonts import in index.css.
Implement a language context or simple state to switch IT/EN text globally.
Build the home page using raw HTML/Tailwind for the bento grids. Embrace asymmetry.
Create a WhatsApp deep link generator for the Booking form based on the state (e.g., https://wa.me/390000000000?text=Ciao%20vorrei%20prenotare...).
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all form inputs, select options, and buttons. This is mandatory.
Set the sticky mobile CTA on all pages.
Write SEO optimized texts utilizing the guidance. Replace placeholder text with rich, context-aware descriptions.
Files should be created as .js or .jsx, not .tsx
